In footage posted to TikTok by Finneas O'Connell’s fiancé, Claudia Sulewski, Hailey Bieber appears to encourage and push Eilish to join the 32-year-old for the song. Once onstage, the “Birds of a Feather” singer, who notably is a Bieber superfan, fell to her knees in disbelief as the Canadian artist came over to embrace her. “I didn’t know where you were,” he could be heard saying. The pair then held hands as they ran to a chair which Eilish sat in. Bieber went on to sing the rest of the track to Eilish, who was still in shock, covering her face at times, as the two continued to embrace throughout.
